description.en: Compare a one-color wordmark with an all-over print on the same cup shape.
description.zh: 同一杯型可选择单色品牌标志，也可做满版印花。

alt.en: Two white rolled-rim cups with a fictional wordmark and a full-coverage wheat print
alt.zh: 两只白色卷口杯，分别使用虚构品牌字标和满版麦穗印花

description.en: Choose a solid color to suit your brand and packaging.
description.zh: 按品牌配色和包装风格选择纸杯专色。

alt.en: Three matching rolled-rim cups in ochre, burgundy and green
alt.zh: 同一卷口杯型的赭黄、酒红和墨绿配色示意

description.en: Compare sizes in the same cup style for different portions.
description.zh: 用同一杯型对比不同尺寸，为不同份量选款。

alt.en: Three white rolled-rim paper cups in decreasing sizes
alt.zh: 三只不同尺寸的白色卷口纸杯

description.en: Compare a display carton and a clear bag for the same cup.
description.zh: 同一杯型可比较展示盒和透明袋两种包装方案。

alt.en: White square cups in a kraft display carton and a clear unbranded bag
alt.zh: 白色方杯的牛皮纸展示盒和无品牌透明袋包装示意

description.en: Use a seasonal print to distinguish a holiday collection.
description.zh: 用节日主题印花区分季节限定系列。

alt.en: Rolled-rim cups with pine sprigs, hearts and spring egg patterns
alt.zh: 带松枝、爱心和彩蛋图案的卷口杯设计示意

description.en: Review a proposed cup shape with a sketch and sample before choosing a design.
description.zh: 结合杯型设计稿和样品选款，再确认设计。

alt.en: A white square rolled-rim cup beside a line drawing of the same shape
alt.zh: 白色方形卷口杯与同款杯型的线稿示意
